name: Countdown
overview: Under the terms of the new TV game, two participants receive 3 million rubles, which they will have to save. In each of the five rounds, they will face intellectual challenges and limited time to solve them. When the time runs out, the counter starts debiting money. In case of an incorrect answer, the players also lose a large sum. In the final, the stars play against each other, and the winner takes all the money they managed to save.
